name: Slave Ignis
original_name: スレーブ イグニス
source:
"Everyone, let us offer our flames to the master!!"
 
Ignis was reborn through the "Magical Gear System", the true power of the S-class artifacts "Material", which serve as the core of Arty Gear and Knight Gear. Her body and mind have been remodeled by the D factor semen of the master who impregnated her, giving her a submissive and loyal personality as a female slave. 

Her physical appearance reflects the master's desires and her sexual compatibility with him is excellent, serving her master wholeheartedly and enjoying a truly happy life from the bottom of her heart.

Her gear's performance has also greatly increased, allowing her to maintain a constant transformation state, or rather, "Slave Ignis" is her true form.

[Translated from [url=https://i.imgur.com/xTGJXhj.jpeg]Part 1 official character description[/url]]

[spoiler]Due to the devil's trap hidden in the gear in the previous installment, Ignis was transformed into the female slave of the man with the D factor, "Haibara Kai," and has now completely transformed from a dignified female knight into a devoted dog filled with allure. She will not hesitate to use her public face as the acting deputy head of the Japanese branch of the Morning Star Knights, and will work together with her new allies to fulfill any tasks for her master.

[Translated from [url=https://i.imgur.com/zOOG894.jpeg]Part 2 official character description[/url]][/spoiler]
